title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff to prevent regional thrashing under failover
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: During the 2026-02-16 regional failover incident (SUP-7881 / ENG-9123) the SLO enforcer started oscillating between open and closed states across regions, causing aggressive load-shedding and cascading rollbacks. Root cause: backoff calculation used a deterministic linear backoff plus a small fixed cooldown; during cross-region failover we observed synchronized enforcement windows that produced thrashing. This hotfix makes the enforcer resilient to synchronized failovers by: 1) switching to exponential backoff with randomized jitter, 2) introducing a configurable minimum cooldown period that is longer during regional failover, and 3) adding a metric to surface enforcer cooldowns so ops can debug behavior quickly.

This PR includes implementation, tests, config changes, docs, and a safe rollout plan. Checklist: - [x] Fix backoff math and add jitter - [x] Add unit/integration tests for decision logic - [x] Expose cooldown and max_backoff via config + Helm values - [x] Add enforcer cooldown metric and dashboard note - [x] Run canary in eu-west-1 for 24h before global rollout

Behavioral compatibility: defaults tuned conservatively to avoid surprising customers (default cooldown increased from 30s -> 120s; max_backoff capped at 15m). Operators can tune these per-tenant or per-region in config. Backport: this is targeted as a hotfix to the 2026-02 branch and included in the next patch release.

review_comments: Miguel Santos (reviewer): Can you explain why we chose exponential backoff vs. randomized linear? Will this impact latency-sensitive tenants?

Asha Patel (author): Exponential plus jitter gives faster recovery for transient spikes while desynchronizing enforcers across regions; defaults are conservative (120s cooldown) to minimize impact on latency-sensitive tenants. Added note to docs and per-tenant override in config.
Emily Chen (reviewer): Tests look good; one nit about the metric label cardinality. Consider limiting tenant label values to prevent high-cardinality tags.
Asha Patel (author): Good catch — removed tenant_id from the high-frequency gauge and added it only to the debug histogram. Updated metrics file accordingly.
Rohit Gupta (approver): Verified on canary (eu-west-1) for 24h under synthetic failover traffic. Observed stable enforcer state and no thrashing. Approving for merge.
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer backoff to prevent rapid thrashing during regional failover. Adds exponential backoff with jitter, configurable cooldown_seconds and max_backoff, and a new enforcer_cooldown_seconds metric. Backported to release-2026-02.
